name: hakim
description: Use ChatGPT as the conversational brain and Hakim as a privacy-minimized, permission-gated Android execution arm.

interface.longDescription: Hakim connects ChatGPT to an authorized Android device through a privacy-minimized execution bridge. For every new chat, model, or session, the unified resume_hakim tool is the canonical first read: it returns fresh device preflight, durable continuation state, current bridge identity, and current video-factory capabilities, so stale chat text never outranks live evidence. The public version can check connectivity, request opening a selected app or HTTP/HTTPS link, navigate Home/Back/Recents, recover durable cross-session work without replaying pending actions, plan cinematic video projects, and—when the verified free-only renderer is enabled—produce and verify bounded MP4 artifacts. Generative GPU providers remain optional enhancements rather than a dependency. Raw screenshots, notifications, arbitrary taps, free-form text entry, shell, and root are not exposed in the public plugin. State-changing device actions remain subject to Hakim and Android approval gates.
capabilities: Resume Hakim from the latest live and durable state after a new chat, model, or session without asking the user to restate prior work
Check whether the paired Hakim Android device is connected
Open an explicitly selected Android app after device approval
Open an explicit HTTP or HTTPS link after device approval
Navigate Home, Back, or Recents after device approval
Check completion status for a previously requested operation
Recover recent operation state after a chat or session change without replaying actions
Resume a goal from a durable checkpoint without replaying pending device actions
Check the current Hakim video-factory capability and renderer state
Plan a bounded cinematic video project
Render and technically verify a bounded MP4 through the configured free-only Hakim renderer when available
defaultPrompt: Resume my latest actual Hakim state and continue from the newest verified baseline without asking me to restate it.
Check whether my authorized Android device is connected through Hakim.
Use Hakim to continue my last unfinished task from its durable checkpoint without replaying completed actions.
